reviews.comment:
Recibí una mala atención. Voy a cargar, me ubico detrás de una camioneta (estaba 3° para entrar) Me mandan del otro lado del surtidor, contrario a la entrada de nafta. Espero nuevamente el turno. Cuando me toca, me dicen que espere que le toca a otro. Uno que entró detrás mío. Le explico la situación, que me enviaron ahí, y así todo me quieren hacer esperar.

(Translated by Google)
I received poor service. I went to fill up, positioned myself behind a pickup truck (I was third in line). They sent me to the other side of the pump, away from the fuel inlet. I waited my turn again. When it was finally my turn, they told me to wait because it was someone else's turn—someone who had gone in after me. I explained the situation, that they had sent me there, and yet they still wanted to make me wait.

reviewReply.comment: Bueno. Muchas gracias por tus comemtarios es una lastima que no hayamos podido atenderte como corresponde

reviews.comment:
Una barbaridad, en la provincia del petróleo esperando 1 hora y media para cargar al rayo del sol con 32 grados. Después en el norte neuquino solo 1 estación qué no es ypf y un modulo que estaba roto. Como van a promocionar el destino si no hay nafta para transitar!!, los funcionarios... un poquito de idea

(Translated by Google)
It's outrageous! In the oil-rich province, we had to wait an hour and a half to fill up in the blazing sun at 32 degrees Celsius. Then, in northern Neuquén, there was only one station that wasn't a YPF, and that station was broken. How are they going to promote the destination if there's no gas to even drive around?! Officials... they need to have a little common sense.

reviewReply.comment: Hola Jorge. Haces una calificación al norte Neuquino y sus servicios en nuestro lugar. Te invito a que nos califiques conti experiencia en miestra estación
